_doc: Caption timing rule, shared by the burned-in captions (src/Captions.tsx) and the SRT (scripts/export_srt.py). Lines are the lyrics as sung (timing/timing_map.json). A line shows from its first word to the next line's start, capped at tail_s after its last word, at least min_s.
_doc_groups: Burned-in captions only (src/Captions.tsx): each line cut into clippings of 1-3 words, one magazine page each (human, 2026-11-10); the line itself follows the rule above. The SRT is line by line.
